title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: Logical ordering: the previous page defines M^+, M^∘, R, SR as kernels of maps out of M_{ρ,σ}, while (148) says 'c'est ici la définition de M_{ρ,σ}' using R. This is circular unless M was already defined in (143) and (148) is meant as a characterisation. It is a presentational gap, not a mathematical error.

(149) as a direct product needs μ2 ∩ (SR×SG) to be the trivial image. This holds only if the antidiagonal μ2 passes through the G_m factor of R (as (147) suggests). Grothendieck does not verify this on the page.
Notation drifts: superscript 0 (previous page) vs ∘ placed on σ (this page), and SR^{0+} vs SR^{+0}. These are harmless.

ideas.what: Defining M_{ρ,σ} as a central product (R_{ρ,σ}×SG)/μ2 and the induced extension 1→SG→M→T→1 with T ≃ R/μ2
ideas.modern_name: central product of group schemes; extension of algebraic groups by a semisimple group
ideas.usually_credited_to: standard (classical group theory / SGA3-style group scheme formalism)
ideas.where_published: general formalism in SGA3; this specific construction belongs to the unpublished 'équation des lacets' notes

ideas.what: Lattice of subgroups cut out by characters χ, ε_3, ε_2 and the exact sequences T^∘→T→μ2×μ2, etc.
Splitting M^+ ≃ SR×SG on the kernel of the 'determinant' character
ideas.modern_name: splitting of a central product on a subgroup meeting the centre trivially

deep.surprise_reason: Pure notational and structural bookkeeping of auxiliary group schemes for the loop-equation project. The content is routine group theory with no new result or connection beyond what the surrounding (already little-studied) manuscript sets up.
transcription_corrections: Under 'SG' in the first line of (150) the handwritten subscript reads 'diag'. Written above the later lines is 'G^+_{ρ,σ}', apparently an alternative name, not part of the Ker(T→G_m) formula.
In (148) the vertical arrows are inclusions annotated 'μ2×μ2' (cokernel labels), with '||' under the first μ2. The first-row arrows read '1 — μ2 → R_{ρ,σ}×SG — M_{ρ,σ} — 1'.
The marginal note reads 'c'est ici la définition de M_{ρ,σ}'.
The third line of (150) reads T^+_{ρ,σ} = M^+_{ρ,σ}/SG = Ker(T_{ρ,σ} → G_m).
Between (150) and the extensions the text reads 'd'où des structures d'extension'; the later phrase reads 'et des suites exactes'.
